verdict.rationale: A probe confirms Poke publishes an llms.txt at poke.com/llms.txt (HTTP 200) with an agent-readable product summary, so an agent can be pointed at it. However, the only evidence is a truncated snippet, the markdown docs variant (docs.md) returns 404, and there is no machine-readable OpenAPI spec, so the depth of the agent-oriented docs is unproven. missing for 10: evidence that llms.txt links to or covers the full docs, markdown/agent-readable versions of doc pages (docs.md 404), a machine-readable API spec (openapi 404), and independent or hands-on corroboration of agents using these docs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: PROBE llms.txt: HTTP 200 at https://poke.com/llms.txt # Poke
